title: Agent Profile Frontmatter Schema
description: Schema for GitHub Copilot custom agent YAML frontmatter, combining VS Code Copilot standards with LightSpeed extensions

name.description: Unique name for the agent. If unset, defaults to filename (without .md or .agent.md suffix)

description.description: REQUIRED: Description of the agent's purpose and capabilities

target.description: Target environment for the agent. If unset, defaults to both environments

oneOf.description: List of tool names the agent can use. Use ['*'] for all tools, [] for no tools

tools.description: Tools available to the agent (read, edit, search, shell, web, custom-agent, etc.)

mcp-servers.description: Additional MCP servers and tools for the agent (organization/enterprise level only)

metadata.description: Custom metadata annotation as name-value pairs

handoffs.description: Handoff configurations for transitioning to other agents

label.description: Display label for the handoff option

prompt.description: Prompt to send to the target agent

send.description: Whether to automatically send the handoff

model.description: LightSpeed extension: Preferred model for the agent (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'claude-3')

version.description: LightSpeed extension: Semantic version of the agent specification

last_updated.description: LightSpeed extension: Last update date (YYYY-MM-DD format)

author.description: LightSpeed extension: Primary author of the agent

maintainer.description: LightSpeed extension: Current maintainer of the agent

file_type.description: LightSpeed extension: File type classification for organization

status.description: LightSpeed extension: Current status of the agent

tags.description: LightSpeed extension: Organizational tags for discovery

visibility.description: LightSpeed extension: Visibility level of the agent

references.description: LightSpeed extension: Related files, documentation, and resources

guardrails.description: LightSpeed extension: Safety constraints and operational boundaries
